name: CodeCompare
description: CodeCompare is a lightweight, browser-based utility designed to visually compare two code snippets side by side.

paragraphs: CodeCompare is a fast, private diff tool that runs entirely in your browser. Paste or drop two versions of some code or text and get a syntax-highlighted, line-by-line comparison — then keep going with batch comparison across files, a 3-way merge with one-click conflict resolution, a local history, and shareable links.

It is plain HTML, CSS and JavaScript with no build step and no backend. Prism.js (core, every language grammar, plugins and themes) and the Fira Code font are bundled in the repository, so it works completely offline from the very first load, and nothing you paste is ever uploaded anywhere.
features: Two inputs — Original and Modified text areas with file upload (max 2 MB) and drag-and-drop on either side. Swap exchanges them; Format JSON pretty-prints valid JSON before comparing.

Unified and Split views — added, removed and unchanged lines with line numbers. Replaced lines get word-level highlights in both views (switchable under Advanced Settings; on those lines the highlight replaces syntax…
Move detection — optionally mark blocks that were moved instead of removed and re-added.
Live Diff — optionally re-compare while you type.
Navigate changes — floating previous/next buttons with a "2 / 5" counter (works with touch), Alt+↓/↑ on the keyboard, and a minimap of where the changes are.
